blocks.orig: Sueños de África Luxury Camp is located in the northwest of Serengeti National Park, just 20 kilometers from the Seronera airstrip. The camp comprises 10 beautifully appointed safari tents, including 2 family tents. A warm and relaxed antique safari-style atmosphere awaits you with white net curtains waving in the wind, comfy beds, large mirrors, private bathrooms, and a spacious sitting area. In the large dining area, a varied international menu with vegetarian and vegan food options is being served, and at dusk, you can gaze at the stars by the fire.
blocks.html: Sueños de África Luxury Camp lies in the northwest of Serengeti National Park, only 20 kilometers from the Seronera airstrip. It has 10 beautifully appointed safari tents, 2 of which are family tents. You can expect a warm, easy-going atmosphere in antique safari style, with white net curtains moving in the breeze, comfortable beds, big mirrors, private bathrooms and a roomy sitting area. The large dining area serves a varied international menu with vegetarian and vegan options, and in the evening you can watch the stars by the fire.
